fields.description: Runs the device pull every 10 minutes via the scheduler
fields.label: Enable Auto Sync

fields.description: How many days back to re-read on each sync, counted from the machine's last sync. Covers device clock drift.
fields.label: Lookback Days

fields.description: Mark the day Half Day when the worked hours fall below this. 0 keeps every day with a punch as Present.
fields.label: Mark Half Day Below Hours

fields.description: When a day ends on an unpaired punch (the exit was never recorded), write a stand-in checkout this many hours after it so the punches pair up. 0 disables it and the day falls back to its first-to-last span.
fields.label: Auto Checkin Hours
